# lifecycle-sync

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001 — The extension activates only on its own entry points](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001.md) — When VS Code loads the extension manifest, the extension SHALL declare VS Code 1.95 as its lowest supported version and as its only activation events the two Studio commands, the Studio Open With editor, the Studio preview panel serializer and the Markdown language, and start only its registrations and the restore of the editor association at activation, leaving the preview engine, the watchers and the diagnostics to the first Studio preview, and contribute no command whose identifier starts with markdown. and no language and no grammar, so that the built-in Markdown support is neither activated nor replaced, and declare that it supports the VS Code Agents window, so that VS Code enables it there without a user setting.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-002 — A background failure is logged to the extension output channel](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-002.md) — When a task the extension starts without waiting for it (a background write, a debounced refresh or a post to the page) is rejected, the extension SHALL report the failure to the logger of the host, the Markdown OKF-Schema Studio output channel in VS Code, instead of leaving an unhandled rejection or writing to the console.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003 — Open Preview to Side opens or reveals a side preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003.md) — When a reader runs Open Preview to Side on a saved Markdown file, the extension SHALL show that file in the side preview that follows the active editor, by creating that preview beside the active editor when none is open and otherwise revealing it, and offer the command only for a resource whose extension is .md; the extension SHALL preview only a saved file with the extension .md, taken from the active editor (a text editor, a text diff, or the Studio Open With tab) or from a file URI the command receives, ignore an argument that is not a URI of the file scheme, and otherwise show the message Open a Markdown file to use Markdown OKF-Schema Studio. or the error Cannot open {path}: {reason} and open no preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-004 — A long render never blocks the text editor, and a render that a newer edit supersedes stops](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-004.md) — When a preview renders a document in the VS Code host, the extension SHALL keep the text editor responsive during a long render, stop a render that a newer edit, a cancel or a closed preview supersedes, and still render when no background thread can start.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010 — Open Preview to Side checks the file it is given](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010.md) — When Open Preview to Side runs, the extension SHALL preview only a saved file with the extension .md, taken from the active editor (a text editor, or the Studio Open With tab) or from a file URI the command receives, ignore an argument that is not a URI of the file scheme, and otherwise show the message Open a Markdown file to use Markdown OKF-Schema Studio. or the error Cannot open {path}: {reason} and open no preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-018 — The Open With editor shows its own Markdown file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-018.md) — When a reader opens a .md file with the optional Markdown OKF-Schema Studio editor through Open With, the extension SHALL resolve the editor at once and show that file in a tab that keeps showing it whatever editor becomes active, leave the other previews open, and show a page that names the refusal or the failure when the document is not a saved .md file or the preview cannot be created.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-024 — The panel title names the document and whether it follows](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-024.md) — When a preview panel is created, restored, switched to another document or finishes a render, the extension SHALL title the side preview Studio · {file name}, a fixed preview with the bare file name, and a panel with no known document Studio, using the title of the document the panel shows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-026 — The side preview follows the active Markdown editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-026.md) — When another saved Markdown file becomes the active editor, or a text diff whose real file is another saved Markdown file becomes the active tab, the extension SHALL switch only the newest side preview that follows the editor to that file, show Preview pending with the message Following the active Markdown editor. until its render ends, apply only the last requested document when the editor changes during the switch, and leave the preview unchanged for any other editor change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-032 — Refresh Preview renders the shown document again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-032.md) — When a reader runs Refresh Preview, by the command or by the Refresh button, the extension SHALL render the document of the newest live preview again from its buffer, unsaved text included, doing nothing when the active text editor shows another document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-038 — Each preview has its own state and only the newest follows](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-038.md) — When several previews are open, the extension SHALL give each its own session with its own document, render queue, file watchers and reading state, and, when VS Code restores several panels, let only the newest follow the active editor, the older ones becoming fixed previews titled with the bare file name.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-039 — Typing renders the new text after a short pause, without writing files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-039.md) — When the text of a document changes, saved or not, the extension SHALL queue a render of the new text in every preview that shows that document, start it after a pause of 40 ms or of twice the last render time when that is longer (at most 1 s), or at once after a block edit is committed, let a running render finish first unless it has run more than 1 s and more than twice the wall-clock time of the last render when the newer render is due (then abort it), without writing to the shown file or to any build output folder of the workspace; a preview whose panel is hidden SHALL not render until the panel is shown, and previews of the same document, revision and render options SHALL share one render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-044 — Changes to files and settings the render depends on render again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-044.md) — When a file that the shown render depends on is changed, created, deleted or renamed below the preview's root, or a markdownOkfSchemaStudio preview, plantuml or frontmatter setting changes, the extension SHALL render the shown document again or bring the page up to date, ignoring file events below build and tool folders of that root.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-048 — A changed setting that the page reads only at startup loads a new page document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-048.md) — When scrollPreviewWithEditor, scrollEditorWithPreview, markEditorSelection or stickyHeadingDepth changes, the extension SHALL load a new page document instead of patching the loaded one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-049 — The status names the render state and shows pending, failed and recovered notices](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-049.md) — When the preview shows a render state, the extension SHALL label the status Preview pending, Preview ready, Preview is stale, Preview unavailable, Preview source missing or Preview recovered, show a pending notice for a slow render and leave a page that is already shown unchanged while a render is pending, and ignore a pending notice whose visible field is not a boolean or whose label or message is not a string or is longer than 500 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-055 — The page ignores a pending notice with an oversized or malformed field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-055.md) — When the page receives a pending notice whose visible field is not a boolean or whose label or message is longer than 500 characters, the extension SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-059 — The status region is a polite live region of plain text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-059.md) — When the extension writes a status, it SHALL write an aside with role status and aria-live polite that holds the label in bold, the message in its own element and the diagnostics as a list, with every text as plain text and never as markup.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-062 — A preview without a source says why and recovers when it returns](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-062.md) — When the source of a preview is not an existing Markdown file inside its root, the extension SHALL replace the page by the status Preview source missing with the reason of the case, and render the source again when its file is created.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-069 — A render of the loaded document updates the page in place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-069.md) — When a render finishes and the loaded page can take its content, the extension SHALL send only the new content of the page as a content patch, which the page applies in place and reports ready, instead of a new page document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-071 — A render that cannot patch loads a new page document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-071.md) — When a render changes the page shell, for example a diagram engine or math appears or disappears, or cannot otherwise be applied to the loaded page as a content patch, the extension SHALL load a new page document instead of a content patch.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-074 — The page refuses a patch whose status lines break the same bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-074.md) — When the page receives a content patch with a malformed status line or with more than 500 lines, a text over 20000 characters or a severity over 50 characters, the extension SHALL ignore the whole patch.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-081 — After a patch the page answers only to the new identifiers](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-081.md) — When a content patch has moved the page to the next render, the page SHALL refuse host messages that name the previous render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-082 — A patch with stale or malformed fields is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-082.md) — When a content patch names the wrong current identifiers or carries malformed fields, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-089 — Equal blocks pair in document order and each kept node is used once](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-089.md) — When two blocks of a patch have the same HTML, the page SHALL pair them with the old equal blocks in document order and use each kept node once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-090 — Nodes the page added itself are never kept](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-090.md) — When the page replaces its content with a patch, it SHALL NOT keep text nodes or nodes that the page added itself and that have no recorded key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-091 — A block with a link has the same key on the first page and after a patch](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-091.md) — When a block holds a link, the page SHALL give it the same key on the first load and after a patch, including a link title that the host wrote itself.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-093 — A document loaded from a patched record gets a fresh nonce](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-093.md) — When the host loads the record of a patched page as a new document, the extension SHALL replace the nonce of the record by a fresh one first.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-094 — Blocks changed by another tool glow briefly](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-094.md) — When the text of a previewed document changes by an undo, a redo or an edit that is neither the preview's own nor the writer typing, the extension SHALL make the blocks the change updated glow once for about 600 ms, with the text readable and nothing moved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-097 — Two settings decide how the panes follow each other](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-097.md) — When the text editor is scrolled or a block of the preview is scrolled to or clicked, the extension SHALL move the other pane only as far as markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor (boolean, on by default) and markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview (boolean, on by default) allow.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-100 — Scrolling the text editor scrolls the preview to the same line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-100.md) — When the text editor of a previewed document, or the side of a text diff that is that document's file, scrolls while the anchor mode is on, the extension SHALL record the editor's first visible line as the anchor of each preview of that document, owned by the editor, and scroll the preview so that this line sits at its reading line, without reporting that scroll back to the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-108 — Scrolling or clicking the preview reveals the source line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-108.md) — When the reader scrolls the preview to another source line or activates a rendered block outside edit mode, the extension SHALL reveal that source line in the visible text editor that shows the preview's file, as the settings allow, and leave every editor unmoved when no visible text editor shows that file or the report names another file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-112 — A double click reveals the source line only when the double-click setting is on](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-112.md) — When the reader double-clicks a rendered block that is not a link outside edit mode and doubleClickToSwitchToEditor is on, the extension SHALL reveal the source line of that block in the text editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-116 — A scroll or reveal report that does not name the current render moves nothing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-116.md) — When a previewScroll or previewReveal does not name the document, the revision and the request of the render the host holds, the extension SHALL NOT move the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-117 — The page ignores a source scroll for another render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-117.md) — When the page receives a sourceScroll that names another document, revision or request than its own, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-119 — Both panes share one reading anchor that survives updates](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-119.md) — When a preview is scrolled, rebuilt, re-laid out or edited, the extension SHALL define its scroll anchor as a source line (the editor's first visible line, and the preview's line at its reading line below the sticky heading band, with the very top of the page always being line 1) and keep that anchor through the update.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-125 — The reading state of recent documents is saved within bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-125.md) — When the page reports its reading state while the reader scrolls, the extension SHALL write the state and post previewState at most once per 100 ms with the last state always reaching the host, record each valid report for the preview's document, and remember the reading state of at most the 200 most recent documents.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-127 — A restored panel reopens its document or explains why it cannot](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-127.md) — When VS Code restores a Studio preview panel, the extension SHALL open in it the Markdown file its saved state names, with the saved reading position, open sections and Description column state, or show the status Preview source missing with the reason the panel cannot be restored.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-136 — A saved state keeps at most 100 open-section indexes between 0 and 9999](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-136.md) — When the extension reads a saved panel state, it SHALL keep at most 100 open-section indexes, each an integer from 0 to 9999, and drop the others.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-137 — A saved state keeps a focused block id of at most 200 characters, a selection of at most 4096 and a boolean Description state](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-137.md) — When the extension reads a saved panel state, it SHALL keep the focused block id up to 200 characters, the selected text up to 4096 characters and descriptionsCollapsed only as a boolean, and drop any other value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-143 — Closing a preview or folder leaves nothing behind](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-143.md) — When a preview panel is closed, a document is closed, a workspace folder is removed or the extension is deactivated, the extension SHALL cancel the render queue and dispose the pending render stages, file watchers, subscriptions and Problems entries of the preview concerned, so that no late result reaches the panel, keeping every shared resource that another live preview still uses. A preview whose workspace folder is removed keeps its panel and shows its file with restricted reads.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-149 — The Studio runs beside the built-in Markdown preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-149.md) — While the Studio runs, the extension SHALL open its side preview beside an open built-in Markdown preview and leave that preview, its commands, the native text diff and every markdown.preview setting and style setting of the built-in Markdown preview as they were.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-151 — A side preview locks its editor group](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-151.md) — When a new side preview opens in an editor group that holds only that panel, the extension SHALL lock the group and, when that locked preview is closed, unlock the group it left empty, one tick later, only if no live preview occupies it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-156 — The settings editor lists the Studio settings in titled groups](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-156.md) — The extension SHALL contribute exactly the settings of its settings registry, with their schema text and defaults generated into package.json, in the groups Preview, Editing, Frontmatter, Comments and PlantUML in that order, each setting with a unique order and a markdownDescription of at most 700 characters, reading a setting with nothing stored, and an absent or wrongly typed boot entry of the page, as its default.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-169 — A view choice made on the page is stored for the workspace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-169.md) — When the writer changes a view choice on the page, the extension SHALL keep it in the saved state of the panel, post it to the host with the identity of the page, and let the host validate it and store it for the workspace according to the table of view choices.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-170 — A new page starts each view choice from the panel, stored or default value](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-170.md) — When a page opens, the extension SHALL start each view choice from the saved panel state, else the stored workspace value, else the default of that choice, except the theme mode, which starts from the stored workspace value before the saved panel state.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-171 — The manifest declares Agents window support](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-171.md) — The extension SHALL declare in its manifest that it supports the VS Code Agents window, so that VS Code enables it in that window without a user setting.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-172 — A document opens in preview mode and E switches to edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-172.md) — When a document opens in a panel, the extension SHALL start the page in preview mode, unless the saved state of that same document holds edit mode, and while the page is in preview mode the extension SHALL switch to edit mode when E is pressed alone outside any text field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-173 — Save key saves the previewed document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-173.md) — When the writer presses the VS Code save key binding with the focus in the side preview, the extension SHALL write the text typed in an open block or table-cell editor to the document and keep that editor open with its caret, write the value typed in an open frontmatter field of the properties table to the document and close that field, then save the document the preview shows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-174 — The Opening Files settings choose when Studio takes the place of a text editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-174.md) — When the reader opens the settings editor, the extension SHALL contribute the group Opening Files with the settings open.searchResultsInStudio (on by default) and open.markdownFilesInStudio (off by default), host-only and of window scope, each described in at most 700 characters with what On and Off do.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-175 — The editor association of Markdown files is migrated to the Studio setting once per scope](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-175.md) — When the extension activates and the user or the workspace settings hold the workbench.editorAssociations entry *.md naming the Studio editor, the extension SHALL remove that entry from that scope, turn on open.markdownFilesInStudio in the same scope, remember the scope as migrated, show the migration notice, and leave every other entry untouched.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-176 — Feature introductions show once and can be shown again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-176.md) — When a feature with an introduction first takes effect, the extension SHALL show its introduction notice once across sessions and workspaces, and when the reader runs Show Feature Introductions Again, the extension SHALL forget every shown introduction so that each shows once more.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-177 — Open as Text replaces a Studio tab by the text editor of the same file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-177.md) — When the reader runs Open as Text on a Studio tab, the extension SHALL open the text editor of the same file in the same group, at the line shown at the top of the Studio page when it is known, close the Studio tab, and never replace that text editor by Studio, with or without the editor association of Markdown files.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-178 — The page marks a requested line with an arrow and a band at the line's place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-178.md) — When the host asks the page to reveal a source line, the page SHALL scroll silently so that the line sits at the reading line below the sticky heading band, unfold a folded heading section or a closed details block that holds it, and draw an arrow in the left margin and a light band at the exact line of a paragraph or of a code block itself, at the top of the enclosing block for any other block (a pipe table row, a tab item and the front matter have their own requirements), and at the nearest block for a line outside every block. When the request asks for the if-off-screen scroll, the page SHALL scroll only when the line is not already on screen below the sticky heading band, and SHALL always draw the marker.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-179 — The line marker stays through scrolls and layout changes and goes on a pointer press, an edit or a new line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-179.md) — While a line marker is shown, the page SHALL keep it when the reader scrolls, draw it again at its source line after a re-render, a content patch or a layout change, and remove it when the reader presses the pointer in the page, when an edit starts, or move it when another line is requested.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-180 — The line marker in edit mode covers no handle or action and opens no editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-180.md) — In edit mode the page SHALL draw the line marker over neither the list item handles, the table row handles nor the block actions, and SHALL open no block editor on its own because of the marker.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-181 — A requested line reaches the page once it is ready and wins over the restored reading place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-181.md) — When a session (the side preview that follows the editor, or a Studio tab) holds a requested line, the session SHALL post the previewRevealLine message to its page once the page is ready and only once, SHALL post it at once when the page is already ready, and the requested line SHALL win over the reading place the page restored for its document. The requested line SHALL belong to a document and an age, and the session SHALL post it only to a visible page that shows that document, and only within 5 seconds, and the line SHALL take the anchor except in the if-off-screen mode, where the editor leads.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-182 — Link and history navigation from a Studio tab opens Studio at the target line when Markdown files open in Studio](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-182.md) — When the reader follows a link or a Back or Next move from a Studio Open With tab to a Markdown file and Open Markdown files in Studio is on, the session SHALL ask the host to show that document in a Studio tab at the target line, and in every other case SHALL ask the host to show it in a text editor as before.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-183 — The host picks the Studio tab to reveal or opens a new one](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-183.md) — When the host puts Studio in place for a file, it SHALL reveal the Studio tab of that file in the text tab's group when there is one, SHALL reveal the most recently active Studio tab of another group for a jump, and SHALL open a new Studio tab in the text tab's group for a plain opening or when the file has no Studio tab yet.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-184 — The opening policy keeps a text editor or replaces it by Studio, by nine ordered rules](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-184.md) — When a Markdown text tab opens, the opening policy SHALL keep it when it is not a text tab, not an eligible saved file .md, not new, present at start, opened by Studio, reopened as text, or a jump while a side preview follows the active editor, and otherwise SHALL replace it by Studio at the line when Open Markdown files in Studio is on or when Open search results in Studio is on and the opening carries a line, and by Studio with no line for a plain opening when Open Markdown files in Studio is on.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-185 — The opening watcher reads each new Markdown text tab and puts Studio in its place after the migration](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-185.md) — When a text tab opens, the opening watcher SHALL read its line from the selection of its editor, SHALL ask the opening policy after the editor association migration is done, SHALL never replace a tab that was open when the watcher started, and SHALL put Studio in the place of the text tab when the policy says so.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-186 — The host tells a jump from a cursor move](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-186.md) — When a text editor of an eligible Markdown file, or a side of a text diff whose real file is one, reports a selection change of kind Command with one selection that Studio did not expect, the host SHALL read it as a jump to the line of that selection in the real file, and SHALL never read a Keyboard, a Mouse or a no-kind change, or a change with several selections, as a jump.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-187 — The side preview that follows the editor marks the line of a jump](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-187.md) — When a jump moves a Markdown text editor to a line, the side preview that follows the active editor SHALL show the line marker on that line of the jump's document, posting it only to a visible page that shows that document within five seconds and dropping it after that, whichever of the jump and the switch of document comes first.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-188 — The side preview's scroll on a jump follows the anchor setting](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-188.md) — When the side preview marks the line of a jump, it SHALL ask the page to scroll only when the line is off screen and leave the scroll anchor to the editor while scrolling the preview with the editor is on, and SHALL ask the page to scroll the line to the reading line and take it as its anchor while that setting is off.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-189 — The line marker of the side preview goes on an edit of the document or a switch of file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-189.md) — While the side preview shows a line marker, the host SHALL tell the page to remove it when the text editor edits the marked document or when the side preview switches to another document, and SHALL keep it through scrolls and cursor moves.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-190 — A cursor move never marks the side preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-190.md) — When the reader moves the cursor with the keyboard or the mouse, or the editor reports a selection change of no kind, the side preview SHALL NOT show the line marker.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-191 — Links and Back and Next followed in the side preview mark their target line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-191.md) — When a link, Back or Next followed in the side preview that follows the editor opens another document at a line, the side preview SHALL mark that line once, and SHALL mark nothing for an anchor link or a Back or Next inside the same document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-192 — The line marker marks the table row of the line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-192.md) — When the line marker is requested on a line of a pipe table, the page SHALL mark the row of that line, the header row for the delimiter line, wherever the table sits (top level, quote, alert, admonition, list item or tab item), and SHALL mark the top of the enclosing block for a line of a list-table, a captioned table, a raw HTML table or a line past the last row.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-193 — The line marker shows the hidden tabs that hold the line and marks its exact line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-193.md) — When the line marker is requested on a line inside a tab item that is not shown, the page SHALL select that tab and every hidden tab around the line, outermost first, the way a click does (the sets of the sync group follow, the focus does not move), unfold a folded section or a closed dropdown around the tab set first, and mark the exact paragraph or code line inside the shown tab, and SHALL select no tab for the tab-set line, nor for a later placement of the marker.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-194 — The line marker marks the front matter property row of the line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-194.md) — When the line marker is requested on a line of the front matter, the page SHALL mark the properties table row of the property that holds the line (a multi-line value included) and expand a collapsed properties table first, and SHALL mark the top of the properties table, leaving a collapsed table collapsed, for a line that is no property line (a fence, a comment, a blank line).
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-195 — The editor association of Markdown files is restored once from the retired Studio setting](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-195.md) — When the extension activates and the user or the workspace settings hold the retired setting open.markdownFilesInStudio turned on, the extension SHALL write the workbench.editorAssociations entry *.md naming the Studio editor in that scope before it removes the retired setting from that scope, leave every other entry untouched, remove the leftover retired settings, and show nothing to the reader.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-196 — A link, Back or Next from a Studio tab opens the target at its line or anchor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-196.md) — When the reader follows a link to a Markdown file, or Back or Next to a place in another Markdown file, in a Studio tab, the extension SHALL hand the target's line or anchor to the Studio tab that shows the target: it SHALL reveal a Studio tab of the target already open in any group in its own group instead of opening a second one, and SHALL hand a pending line to a new Studio tab once, removing it as soon as it is delivered.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-197 — The history of a link followed from a Studio tab](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-197.md) — When the reader follows a link from a Studio tab to a Markdown file, the extension SHALL record the move in the Studio tab's navigation history only when the target opens in a Studio tab, sharing that history with a Studio tab the link created and appending the move to the own history of a Studio tab already open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-198 — Open in Studio at This Line opens a Studio tab at the caret's line and keeps the text tab](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-198.md) — When the reader runs Open in Studio at This Line on a Markdown text editor, the extension SHALL open a Studio tab of the file in the text editor's group with the caret's line revealed and marked, and SHALL close no tab.
